description: This file implements a stress-testing application for disk cache crash recovery, involving process management, cache operations, multi-threading, and crash simulation.

classes.name: EntryWrapper
classes.description: Encapsulates cache entry operations including open, read, write, delete, and idle management.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoOpen
methods.description: Initiates opening or creating a cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnOpenDone
methods.description: Handles completion of open/create cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoWrite
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the cache entry.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::OnWriteDone
methods.description: Handles completion of write operation and decides next steps.

methods.name: EntryWrapper::DoIdle
methods.description: Marks the entry as idle and schedules next operation.

methods.name: StressTheCache
methods.description: Main function that runs the cache stress test loop with process crash simulation.

methods.name: CrashCallback
methods.description: Triggers process termination to simulate crash.

methods.name: StartCrashThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that periodically crashes the process.

methods.name: CrashHandler
methods.description: Handles crash signals, triggers debugger break.
